purpose: Freeze executable SI, frame, time and passive Hamilton quaternion conventions before product math types are implemented.

provenance.notes: ADR-0006 and ADR-0007 narrow the blueprint rules into a fixture-level profile. The bundle is independent of Simulator and legacy output layout.

expected_facts.claim: Column-vector passive transforms use Hamilton multiplication, right-order composition, exact wxyz serialization and explicitly labelled Euler conversion.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Serialization and check identities are exact; computed rotation values use the tolerance in cases.json.

expected_facts.claim: Runtime physical values use SI and radians, with non-SI and offset conversions confined to declared boundaries.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Converted numeric values use the tolerance in cases.json; unit identities and boundary names are exact.

expected_facts.claim: R_to_from has one direction and point transforms differ from free-vector transforms by translation.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Matrix/vector values use the tolerance in cases.json; frame direction and transform category are exact.

expected_facts.claim: Fixed-step logical time is derived from integer tick and five public time identities remain distinct.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Tick identity and policy names are exact; derived seconds use the tolerance in cases.json.

expected_facts.claim: An isolated C++17 property implementation and a CPython-standard-library reference agree with fixture expectations.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Every required check passes and every observation satisfies absolute plus relative tolerance.

acceptance: Direction, multiplication, composition, serialization, SI, frame and time policies have executable checks
C++ and Python implementations do not import or link Legacy or Simulator
Cross-tool evidence records normalized source hashes and zero mismatches
